name: opacity-checkerboard
description: Opacity checkerboards provide a visual pattern background used in color swatches and UI elements to indicate transparency or when no color is selected.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: The patterned surface. It holds the squares and sets no values of its own.

anatomy.name: square
anatomy.description: Single square of the checkerboard pattern; the pattern alternates two colors, both set on the square.

anatomyReview.notes: No Figma page; it appears only as the Checkerboard layer inside other components. React Spectrum S2 draws an inline repeating-conic-gradient and SWC gen2 a CSS fragment with tokens opacity-checkerboard-square-{size,dark,light}. container is the explicit root; square is the tile and carries the size and both colors. How dark and light are told apart is left to the data migration (5m92.6); the square-light value conflict stays with bead 5m92.5.10.
